verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Asana creating and managing tasks and projects ([asana-docs-35], [asana-docs-21]) and syncing with engineering tools like GitHub, GitLab, Jira and Bitbucket ([asana-intdir-13], [asana-intdir-14], [asana-intdir-15], [asana-intdir-16]). Community comments imply board/task-list usage and developer adoption ([asana-comm-1], [asana-comm-2]). Nothing in the pack documents sprint-specific agile features, so this is only glancing support for the story. Missing for 10: documented sprint/iteration planning, backlog management, story points or estimation, velocity or burndown reporting, and hands-on corroboration of agile sprint workflows.
